intro.zh: 深色开场配橙色焦点，超大标题与明暗交替的功能页；适合新品发布、功能亮点和定价说明。
intro.en: Dark hero opening with one orange focal point, oversized headlines and alternating light and dark feature pages; for product launches, feature highlights and pricing.
intro.ja: ダークなヒーローページにオレンジのアクセント、大きな見出しと明暗が交互の機能ページ。新製品発表や価格説明向け。

pageMapping.differences: Source is left-aligned with one headline line in orange, a logo mark and a product visual on an orange disc at the right; native is a centred title on the dark page with no coloured line, logo or product visual.

Source is a white page with a centred eyebrow, oversized product name and two-line subtitle; native statement is on the dark canvas and its kicker is left-aligned at the top while the statement is centred.

Source is a white page with a large two-line headline, an orange eyebrow and three white rounded cards each with an orange icon tile; native has a dark title band with a small one-line title and three peach-tinted cards without icons.
Source turns the whole page dark with a large white headline and three dark bordered cards; native content pages stay white with only a dark title band, and the cards are peach-tinted.
Source is a large two-line headline over two wide white cards with orange icon tiles; native has a dark title band with a small title and tinted cards without icons.
Source is a vertical list of three numbered orange circles with a title and a line of text beside each; native is one horizontal row of outlined boxes joined by arrows, without numerals.

Source is three plan cards with a plan label, a large price figure and hairline-separated feature rows, the middle plan a raised dark card with a glow; native is three tinted cards with a title and bullets, the middle only outlined in orange, no price figure or dark card.

Source is a two-column dark page: a serif customer quote with attribution on the left, and a price with an orange gradient button on the right; native is a centred sign-off title, subtitle and meta line with no quote column, price or button.
